proof.factorization_constraint: If Var_pi(f)<=A*totalConditionalVariance(f) for every continuous gauge-invariant f and A>=0, applying it to the constructed positive-variance plaquette proves A*N_links>=1.

proof.scope: The rate is exactly the coefficient appearing in the earlier explicit_slab_contraction theorem. An upper bound tending to one need not mean the actual transfer ratio tends to one.
proof.no_eventual_cap: No cap r<1 holds even eventually in the cutoff index; deleting a finite initial segment cannot repair the coefficient.
